checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.9 with metadata; all volumes are within pipette ranges (40, 125, 180, 166.7, 100 and 80 µL on the p300 multi; 250 µL on the p1000); reservoir columns stay under 15 mL per the check; the magnet and temperature module are used correctly.

The p1000 takes a fresh tip for each of the 48 samples (check passed); the multi uses one tip for reagents that is dispensed above the wells and never touches samples; every removal and elution step uses a fresh tip per column; every tip is dropped.

The module docstring and metadata credit the paper to 'Lopez-Fernandez et al.', but the authors are Lázaro-Perona et al., so the metadata is inaccurate. The code also adds an unspecified bead-resuspension mix (m300.mix(5,150,beads...)).
The checks '48_samples_to_odd_columns' and 'distinct_elution_wells' passed; sample_tubes map one-to-one to the odd-column wells, and each column is recovered to the same column of the elution plate.
Code adds 40 µL beads, then 250 µL isopropanol, then 250 µL sample with mix(5, 250); delay 5 min, engage, delay 4 min, then removes 540 µL with the magnet on; the checks all passed.
The loop runs two washes, each adding 500 µL ethanol and removing it with the magnet engaged; a 4 min delay follows with the magnet still engaged, and disengage comes before elution (checks passed).

The magnet is disengaged, 100 µL elution buffer is added and mixed 10x, then delay 30 s, engage, delay 90 s, and 80 µL goes to a distinct elution-plate well with the temperature module set to 4 °C at the start.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and passes all 17 measured checks. The binding, wash, elution, tip-handling and sample-mapping items are all correct. Fidelity fails because the metadata and docstring misattribute the paper to 'Lopez-Fernandez et al.' and because an unspecified bead-resuspension mix was added.
